findings.text: follow-on: the search text now diverges from its pre-change output on 54 of 155 committed plans (e.g. a-landing-beat-needs-no-hand-edit.html 329 to 193 words, a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner.html differing at its tail) because section_prose subtracts landed-card interiors by default, while the done-when states the search text equals its base output up to whitespace normalisation; tests/test_the_section_prose_reader_has_one_home.py:129 pins it to the reader's join instead of to a base output, so the node's own declared measure is satisfied by neither the code nor the test.

justifications.evidence: gate.log line 1 names the commit and ends EXIT=0 over 277 passed, but the done-when's search-text/section-text base-parity clause is unmeasured and unmet — the shipped pin at tests/test_the_section_prose_reader_has_one_home.py:129 asserts equality with the reader's own join, not with a base output, and the two differ on 54 of 155 plans.
